column3: .abogado is Spanish for lawyer — sharpest for practices serving Spanish-speaking clients, about $26/yr flat; .lawyer speaks to English-speaking clients at about $50/yr flat. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.abogado 是西班牙语「律师」后缀，面向西语客户的律师定位最准，注册约 $26/年续费同价；.lawyer 面向英语客户，注册续费均约 $50/年。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.actor writes the performing profession into the address — sharpest for actor portfolios and casting profiles, about $35/yr flat; .studio names the creative team, the generic signboard for design, film and game shops. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.actor 把表演职业写进域名，演员个人官网与选角展示定位最准，注册约 $35/年续费同价；.studio 说创作团队，设计、影像、游戏工作室的通用招牌。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。
.amsterdam was launched by the City of Amsterdam and run by SIDN, about $39/yr flat; .berlin is Berlin's official suffix at about $42/yr flat. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.amsterdam 由阿姆斯特丹市政府发起、SIDN 运营，注册约 $39/年续费同价；.berlin 是柏林官方后缀，注册约 $42/年续费同价。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.ar is Argentina's country domain at about $36/yr flat, open to anyone since 2019 (NIC Argentina registration required); .cl is Chile's at about $18/yr flat, open worldwide (a local contact is required; registrars provide one). See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.ar 是阿根廷国家域名、约 $36/年平续、2019 年起任何人可注册（需 NIC Argentina 登记）；.cl 是智利国家域名、约 $18/年平续、向全球开放（需本地联系人，注册商可代办）。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.at is Austria's country domain at about $14/yr flat, open to anyone, with preposition hacks like meet.at; .de is Europe's largest ccTLD (18 million names as of June 2026, per DENIC) at about $8/yr flat, the default for the German market. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.at 是奥地利国家域名、约 $14/年平续、任何人可注册，还能拼 meet.at 类短语域名；.de 是欧洲最大的 ccTLD（2026-06 突破 1,800 万，DENIC）、约 $8/年平续，德国市场标配。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.au opened direct registration only in 2022 — fresh inventory on decades of trust at about $12/yr flat, gated by Australian presence rules; .com is the global default with empty shelves. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.au 2022 年才开放二级直注、库存新鲜且本地信任几十年，约 $12/年平续但需澳大利亚存在资格；.com 全球通用但好名字绝迹。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.be is Belgium's country domain at about $9 to register and $10/yr to renew, with verb hacks like youtu.be; .nl is the world's third-largest ccTLD with top Dutch penetration at about $9 to register and $10/yr to renew. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.be 是比利时国家域名、注册约 $9、续费约 $10/年，还能拼 youtu.be 式短语域名；.nl 是全球第三大 ccTLD、荷兰渗透率极高、注册约 $9、续费约 $10/年。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.berlin is Berlin's official city suffix — sharpest for local positioning at about $42/yr flat; .city is the generic city word for any town, about $5 to register and $23/yr to renew. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.berlin 是柏林官方城市后缀，本地定位最准，注册约 $42/年续费同价；.city 是通用城市词，任何城市都能用，注册约 $5 续费约 $23/年。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.boston is Boston's city-endorsed suffix — sharpest for local businesses and education or healthcare institutions, about $19/yr flat; .city names the generic idea of a city, usable for any town, about $5 first year then $23/yr. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.boston 是波士顿官方城市后缀，本地商家与教育医疗机构定位最准，注册约 $19/年续费同价；.city 说泛城市语义，任何城市的指南站都能用，首年约 $5 续费约 $23/年。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.br is Brazil's country domain at about $8/yr flat, gated by a Brazilian tax ID; .mx is Mexico's, open to anyone, at about $13 in year one but ~$50/yr renewal. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.br 是巴西国家域名、约 $8/年平续、需巴西税号；.mx 是墨西哥国家域名、任何人可注册、首年约 $13 但续费约 $50/年。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.br is Brazil's country domain at about $8/yr flat, gated by a Brazilian tax ID (CPF/CNPJ); .pt is Portugal's at about $15/yr flat, open to anyone. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.br 是巴西国家域名、约 $8/年平续、需巴西税号（CPF/CNPJ）；.pt 是葡萄牙国家域名、约 $15/年平续、任何人可注册。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.ca is gated by Canadian Presence Requirements with top local trust at about $13/yr flat; .us needs a US nexus, costs little and plays phrase puns but forbids WHOIS privacy. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.ca 需满足加拿大存在要求、本地信任度极高且约 $13/年平续；.us 需美国关联、便宜且可玩短语梗但禁止 WHOIS 隐私。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.ch is Switzerland's country domain with a "Swiss made" quality halo at about $12/yr flat, open to anyone; .de is Europe's largest ccTLD (18 million names as of June 2026, per DENIC) at about $8/yr flat, the default for the German market. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.ch 是瑞士国家域名、自带「瑞士制造」品质联想，约 $12/年平续、任何人可注册；.de 是欧洲最大的 ccTLD（2026-06 突破 1,800 万，DENIC）、约 $8/年平续，德国市场标配。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.cl is Chile's country domain at about $18/yr flat, open worldwide (a local Chilean contact is required; registrars provide one); .mx is Mexico's, open to anyone, at about $13 in year one but ~$50/yr renewal. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.cl 是智利国家域名、约 $18/年平续、向全球开放（需智利本地联系人，注册商可代办）；.mx 是墨西哥国家域名、任何人可注册、首年约 $13 但续费约 $50/年。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.college names the institutional identity of a college — sharpest for vocational schools and test-prep brands, about $52/yr flat; .academy names the skills bootcamp, the generic front for training of every kind. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.college 说「学院」这个机构身份，职业院校与备考机构定位最准，注册约 $52/年续费同价；.academy 说技能训练营，编程、健身、语言培训的通用门牌。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.condos names owned units — sharpest for development sales and vacation condos, about $47/yr flat; .apartments names rentals, the default for long-stay brands and leasing pages, about $11 then $46/yr. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.condos 说产权公寓，楼盘销售与度假公寓定位最准，注册约 $47/年续费同价；.apartments 说租赁公寓，长租品牌与招租页的标配，注册约 $11 续费约 $46/年。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.cz is Czechia's country domain at about $10/yr flat, open to anyone; .pl is Poland's at about $6 in year one but ~$25/yr renewal, equally zero-bar. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.cz 是捷克国家域名、约 $10/年平续、任何人可注册；.pl 是波兰国家域名、首年约 $6 但续费约 $25/年、同样零门槛。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.de is Europe's largest ccTLD (18 million names as of June 2026, per DENIC) with German local trust and local-SEO upside at about $8/yr flat; .com is the global default with empty shelves. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.de 是欧洲最大的 ccTLD（DENIC：2026 年 6 月突破 1,800 万）、德国本地信任与本地 SEO 双加成，注册约 $8/年平续；.com 全球通用但好名字绝迹。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。
.de is the default signal for the German market at about $8/yr flat; .eu says "we serve all of Europe" but requires EU/EEA eligibility. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.de 是德国市场的默认信号、约 $8/年平续；.eu 讲「服务全欧洲」但需欧盟/EEA 资格。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.dk is Denmark's country domain at about $12/yr flat with registry ID validation and a Nordic design halo; .se is Sweden's at about $15/yr flat, open to anyone, with a Stockholm-innovation halo. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.dk 是丹麦国家域名、约 $12/年平续、注册需身份验证，自带北欧设计联想；.se 是瑞典国家域名、约 $15/年平续、任何人可注册，自带斯德哥尔摩创新圈联想。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.domains writes the domain industry into the address itself — sharpest for registrars and domain tools, about $35/yr flat; .tools names any online utility. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.domains 把域名行业写进域名本身，注册商与域名工具定位最准，注册约 $35/年续费同价；.tools 说通用工具，任何在线小工具都能用。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.ee is Estonia's country domain at ~$12/yr, requiring non-local registrants to appoint an in-country contact (registrars arrange it); .fi is Finland's at ~$10/yr, open to anyone. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.ee 是爱沙尼亚国家域名、约 $12/年、非本地注册人需指定境内联系人（注册商可代办）；.fi 是芬兰国家域名、约 $10/年、任何人可注册。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.eg is Egypt's country domain at ~$90/yr via accredited registrars (foreign firms may need a local agent); .sa is Saudi Arabia's at ~$55/yr, requiring a Saudi CR or trademark. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.eg 是埃及国家域名、约 $90/年、经授权注册商办理（外企或需本地代理）；.sa 是沙特国家域名、约 $55/年、需沙特商业登记或商标。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.es is Spain's country domain — no eligibility restrictions, anyone can register — at about $8 to register and $10/yr to renew; .eu is the EU's official domain covering all of Europe but requiring EU/EEA eligibility. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.es 是西班牙国家域名、无资格限制任何人可注册，注册约 $8、续费约 $10/年；.eu 是欧盟官方域名、覆盖全欧但需欧盟/EEA 资格。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.fi is Finland's country domain at about $10/yr flat, open to anyone, with a Helsinki gaming-tech halo; .se is Sweden's at about $15/yr flat, open to anyone, with a Stockholm-innovation halo. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.fi 是芬兰国家域名、约 $10/年平续、任何人可注册，自带赫尔辛基游戏科技联想；.se 是瑞典国家域名、约 $15/年平续、任何人可注册，自带斯德哥尔摩创新圈联想。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.fr is France's country domain with local trust and French-market SEO upside at about $9 to register and $10/yr to renew, EU/EEA eligibility required; .com is the global default with empty shelves. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.fr 是法国国家域名、本地信任与法语市场 SEO 双加成，注册约 $9、续费约 $10/年，需欧盟/EEA 资格；.com 全球通用但好名字绝迹。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。
.ge is Georgia's country domain at ~$30/yr, open to anyone; .tr is Turkey's at ~$15/yr, equally open. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.ge 是格鲁吉亚国家域名、约 $30/年、任何人可注册；.tr 是土耳其国家域名、约 $15/年、同样完全开放。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.gmbh is the dedicated suffix for German-speaking limited companies — same word as the register entry, about $37/yr flat but GmbH-entities only; .company names any company anywhere, renewing near $17/yr, the cheapest tier. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.gmbh 是德语区有限责任公司的专属后缀，与工商注册名同词，注册约 $37/年续费同价但要求 GmbH 实体资格；.company 说泛公司语义，任何主体都能用且续费约 $17/年最便宜。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.gr is Greece's country domain, billed in two-year terms at an effective ~$14/yr, open to anyone; .tr is Türkiye's at about $15/yr flat, open to everyone since 2023. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.gr 是希腊国家域名、按两年计费折合约 $14/年、任何人可注册；.tr 是土耳其国家域名、约 $15/年平续、2023 年起任何人可直注。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.healthcare is the umbrella term for the medical industry — sharpest for health systems and care platforms, about $71/yr flat; .health spans wellness and fitness too, about $11 first year then $62/yr. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.healthcare 是医疗行业的总称后缀，医疗集团与健康平台定位最准，注册约 $71/年续费同价；.health 说泛健康（含健身养生），首年约 $11 续费约 $62/年。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.hk is Hong Kong's regional domain — no eligibility restrictions, anyone can register — at about $25/yr flat, radiating across the Greater Bay Area and Chinese-speaking markets; .sg is Singapore's country domain at about $39/yr flat with local presence required and compliance connotations across Southeast Asia. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.hk 是香港地区域名、无资格限制任何人可注册，约 $25/年平续，面向大湾区与两岸三地商圈；.sg 是新加坡国家域名、约 $39/年平续、需本地存在，在东南亚商圈自带合规联想。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.hospital names the institutional tier — sharpest for general and specialty hospitals and care facilities, about $46/yr flat; .clinic covers every outpatient health service, from chains to consulting plays. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.hospital 说「医院」这个机构层级，综合与专科医院、康复与护理机构定位最准，注册约 $46/年续费同价；.clinic 覆盖一切门诊制健康服务，连锁门诊与咨询生意通用。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.hu is Hungary's country domain at about $20/yr flat, requiring EU/EEA status or a Hungarian trademark (registrar proxies available); .cz is Czechia's at about $10/yr flat, open to anyone. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.hu 是匈牙利国家域名、约 $20/年平续、需欧盟/EEA 身份或匈牙利商标（注册商可代理）；.cz 是捷克国家域名、约 $10/年平续、任何人可注册。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.id is Indonesia's country domain that naturally reads as English "ID/identity", at about $8 in year one but ~$30/yr renewal; .me is Montenegro's, long genericized as the personal-brand suffix, priced close to .com. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.id 是印度尼西亚国家域名、天然读作英文 ID/身份、首年约 $8 但续费约 $30/年；.me 是黑山国家域名、早已通用化为个人品牌后缀、价格与 .com 接近。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.id is Indonesia's country domain, open to anyone, at about $8 in year one but ~$30/yr renewal; .sg is Singapore's at about $39/yr flat, requiring local presence (registrar proxies available). See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.id 是印度尼西亚国家域名、任何人可注册、首年约 $8 但续费约 $30/年；.sg 是新加坡国家域名、约 $39/年平续、需本地存在（注册商可代理）。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.ie is Ireland's country domain at about $25/yr flat, requiring proof of an Irish connection, with an "EU + English" double position; .uk is the UK's at about $6/yr flat with tens of millions of registrations. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.ie 是爱尔兰国家域名、约 $25/年平续、需证明爱尔兰联系，自带「欧盟 + 英语」双重定位；.uk 是英国国家域名、约 $6/年平续、上千万注册量。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.il is Israel's country domain — .co.il ~$18/yr fully open, direct .il ~$25/yr opening in phases; .com is the global default at ~$10-15/yr but with good names nearly exhausted. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.il 是以色列国家域名，.co.il 约 $18/年完全开放、顶级直注约 $25/年分阶段放开；.com 是全球默认商业后缀、约 $10-15/年但好名字几乎注光。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.immo is the everyday French/German abbreviation for real estate — sharpest for continental-European agencies, about $28/yr flat; .estate speaks the English market's language, the general front for agencies and developers. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.immo 是法语/德语不动产行业缩写，欧陆房产中介定位最准，注册约 $28/年续费同价；.estate 面向英语市场的地产语义，中介与开发商的通用门面。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.immobilien is the full German word for real estate, mapping one-to-one to brokerage firm names, about $8 first year then $30/yr; .immo is the four-letter abbreviation at about $28/yr flat. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.immobilien 是德语「房地产」全称后缀，与中介公司名一一对应，首年约 $8 续费约 $30/年；.immo 是更短的缩写，注册约 $28/年续费同价。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.is is Iceland's country domain at ~$62/yr and the English verb "is" itself — a first-class domain hack; .fi is Finland's at ~$10/yr, open to anyone. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.is 是冰岛国家域名、约 $62/年、还是英语系动词 is 本身，域名黑客玩法一流；.fi 是芬兰国家域名、约 $10/年、任何人可注册。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.it is Italy's country domain with 3.5M registrations at about $8 to register and $10/yr to renew, EU/EEA eligibility required, plus IT double-meaning hacks; .de is Europe's largest ccTLD (18 million names as of June 2026, per DENIC) at about $8/yr flat. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.it 是意大利国家域名、约 350 万注册量，注册约 $8、续费约 $10/年，需欧盟/EEA 资格，兼有 IT 双关玩法；.de 是欧洲最大的 ccTLD（2026-06 突破 1,800 万，DENIC）、约 $8/年平续。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.jp is Japan's most trusted market entrance at about $40/yr flat with a local-address requirement; .cn is affordable and ICP-filing friendly with real-name verification. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.jp 是日本市场信任度最高的入口、约 $40/年平续、需日本联系地址；.cn 价格亲民、备案合规友好、需实名认证。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.kaufen is German for to buy — sharpest for German-market commerce and promo pages, about $6 first year then $24/yr; .shop is the most recognized e-commerce suffix worldwide, cheap year one with notably higher renewals. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.kaufen 是德语「购买」后缀，德语区电商与促销页定位最准，首年约 $6 续费约 $24/年；.shop 是全球认知最成熟的电商后缀，首年常有低价促销但续费明显更高。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.ke is Kenya's country domain — direct registration ~$50/yr (.co.ke ~$10/yr), open to anyone; .ng is Nigeria's — direct ~$36/yr (.com.ng ~$10/yr), equally open. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.ke 是肯尼亚国家域名、顶级直注约 $50/年（.co.ke 约 $10/年）、任何人可注册；.ng 是尼日利亚国家域名、顶级直注约 $36/年（.com.ng 约 $10/年）、同样开放。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。

.kr is South Korea's country domain with a K-wave authenticity halo at about $40/yr flat, Korean contact address required; .jp is Japan's country domain and among Asia's most trusted ccTLDs at about $40/yr flat. See “Which to pick” on this page for the full verdict.
.kr 是韩国国家域名、K 系品牌自带「韩流正品」联想，约 $40/年平续、需韩国联系地址；.jp 是日本国家域名、亚洲信任度最高的 ccTLD 之一，约 $40/年平续。完整结论见本页「怎么选」一节。
